A strip of brown magnetic tape is pulled out from the left side, forming a loose loop. There is illegible, gibberish text in the bottom left corner and some distorted markings on the cassette label area.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'tape loop' on the left. Real magnetic tape is very thin and flat; AI often renders it as a thick, rubbery ribbon. Check if the text artifacts are confined to the label or if they bleed into the background. Verify if the internal spool geometry is mechanically plausible (e.g., do the gears look like they could actually wind tape?).
